title: boechera holboellii
intro: Boechera holboellii, commonly known as Holboell's rockcress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family, native to the mountainous regions of North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Boechera holboellii include its ability to reduce inflammation, ease respiratory issues, and support digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
